pathforge_fit_adaptation: The outside demand is getting from vague SEO/content intent to a concrete content refresh plan. This seed changes that into a deterministic offline mobile-first sorter where a user pastes article titles, stale claims, competitor angles, and target keywords, then gets a prioritized refresh brief with scoring, FAQ gaps, snippet promises, copy, and local export. It is self-contained so PathForge can mount and verify it without external APIs, hosted AI calls, remote fonts, CDN assets, or multi-file bundles.
final_artifact_clue: One-file offline Blog Refresh Brief Sorter HTML tool that builds scored cards, FAQ gaps, snippet promises, and copy/exportable refresh brief text.
